app.title: Training a 4B model to produce 81% faster query plans than Postgres
app.author: polyphilz
app.description: A 4B parameter language model fine-tuned to generate optimized PostgreSQL query plans, claiming significant performance gains
proposed_tests: Run the provided script to generate query plans for a benchmark dataset
Compare execution time of generated plans against hand-tuned Postgres plans
Verify that the model accepts a query and outputs a valid PostgreSQL plan
